release_notes: Sembl now exposes an authenticated project factory API at /api/v1/projects.
New projects persist workspace membership, project, base graph version, main branch, starter specification drafts, ProjectCreated event, and recipient notification.
The app no longer auto-attaches every authenticated user to the seed workspace.
The public graph versions route is read-only; graph compilation moved to the specification compile workflow.
Execution completion records missing deployment integrations as not_deployed instead of fabricating healthy Vercel deployments.
The UI now has a project launcher, project switcher, Overview/Specifications/Execution/Changes/Deployments/Settings views, search, and dark/bright theme.
